## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result and why it belongs in Project Mentor.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests pass.
- [ ] Full tests, lint, format, strict typing, and coverage gate pass.
- [ ] The local eval gate passes and semantic results are refreshed when behavior changed.
- [ ] Public skill structure and canonical/public parity pass when applicable.
- [ ] Behavioral or baseline evaluation was updated when semantic behavior changed.

## Trust and compatibility

- [ ] Agent work is not used as evidence of user capability.
- [ ] Persistence remains opt-in and no real secret, private path, or raw reasoning is included.
- [ ] Schema and host compatibility impact is documented.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when behavior changed.
